title: Final Test - Writing path
description: Two tasks: a practical typed message + a handwritten personal text (uploaded). Teacher-graded.
canDoStatement: Prove course-wide writing ability, including handwriting

writingTask.writingPrompt:
TASK 1 - PRACTICAL WRITING (typed, ~10 minutes)
Situation shown in app:
You are sick today, and you have an English class at
the school this afternoon. Write a message to your
teacher (5-6 sentences):
- say you are sick + ONE symptom (have + ...)
- say what you can't do
- one sentence with -ing: what is happening at home
now
- ask ONE question (about the homework, the next
class, a word...)
- say when the teacher sees you again (day - T8)

TASK 2 - PERSONAL TEXT (HANDWRITTEN + uploaded, ~20 minutes)
Choose ONE prompt card (the app offers all three):
A) MY LIFE - who you are, family, home, work or
study, one hobby
B) A PERSON I LOVE - who + description + clothes +
what they do every day + what they can do
C) MY PERFECT SATURDAY - morning to night: weather,
food, places, free time (careful: all in PRESENT
tense - what you DO on your perfect Saturday!)

Requirements:
- 10-12 sentences BY HAND on paper
- Then photograph and upload
minimumRequirements: Task 2: 10-12 handwritten sentences on the chosen prompt

teacherNotes: Source: tasilla_final_test_writing.txt. SKILL PATH FINAL TEST. Task 2 depends on writing-upload feature (typed fallback). XP 30 +20.

criteria.title: Task 1: message complete - all 5 content points
Task 2: 10-12 sentences, on the chosen prompt, organized
Task 2: grammar range - to be, have, present + -s, do-system or can, one time expression
Vocabulary range: words from 8+ different topics across both tasks
